name: NACA 4-digit generator
description: Example extension: generates a NACA 4-digit section from the parameters below (chord = axial chord, no stagger). Copy this folder to author your own generator - see extensions/README.md for the plugin contract.

parameters.label: Max camber m
parameters.tooltip: Maximum camber as a fraction of the chord (first digit x 1/100). 0 gives a symmetric section.

parameters.label: Camber position p
parameters.tooltip: Chordwise position of maximum camber (second digit x 1/10).

parameters.label: Thickness t
parameters.tooltip: Maximum thickness as a fraction of the chord (last two digits x 1/100).

parameters.label: Cosine spacing exponent
parameters.tooltip: Point clustering exponent near the LE (1 = plain cosine spacing).
